latest_cos_commentary.headline: Apex Order Pickup Solutions makes smart lockers and off-premise order-handoff technology, deployed across 5,000+ sites spanning restaurants and other verticals.
latest_cos_commentary.genius_exposure: Competes on kitchen_drive_thru/off-premise fulfillment hardware, specifically order-pickup automation rather than core pos or payments.
latest_cos_commentary.competitive_timing: Continued product expansion (2025 locker launch, 2026 automation features) shows active investment in the off-premise pickup category.
latest_cos_commentary.sales_response: Relevant when a prospect is evaluating off-premise/digital order-pickup infrastructure alongside or integrated with POS, not as a POS/payments alternative.
latest_cos_commentary.risk_and_uncertainty: Deployment count spans multiple industries; restaurant-specific penetration is not separately broken out in available sources.
